note: The main camping spot is a mown grass field with a small gravel lot on County Road 675, about 600 m south of the area headquarters and Cypress Lake, with managed wetland pools behind a ditch and treeline to the west. Two more primitive spots are mapped 4 km south-west by the St. Francis River, at the County Road 691 ditch bridge and at the end of the Cul-De-Sac road. This is a waterfowl area: the map puts every camping spot inside or at the edge of a Waterfowl Hunting Only Zone from October 15 (to February 15 at the main field), and the pools just north of the field are refuge closed to all uses until March 31, so ask the area office before planning a late fall or winter stay. No facilities at the spots, and spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Individual Campsites' - three GIS camping points, two drawn on the 2022 map; the pin is the main one, an open mown field with a gravel lot on CR 675. Free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches. Season conflict flagged (manual year-round vs the map's Waterfowl Hunting Only Zones).
flags: INCLUSION: the area page lists 'Camping: Individual Campsites'; the brochure (7/2024) says 'Primitive camping is permitted only in designated areas on the area map'. The 10/17/2022 map draws a campfire symbol (not in its legend) at two places: (1) on CR 675 at the north-east corner of unit 14, = GIS point 43 at 36.71374,-90.10151, the stored pin; (2) at the CR 691 / 870 Expressway junction by the St. Francis River, = GIS point 44 at 36.69518,-90.13913. A third GIS point (OBJECTID 393, 36.69982,-90.14455) lies by the Cul-De-Sac road end and has no map symbol. On imagery (1) is an open mown field ~50 x 60 m with a ~20 m gravel lot at its south end (GIS lot 2572, 56 m from the point) directly off the county road - a 23-ft rig fits easily; (2) falls under canopy inside the road wye beside the ditch bridge, with only road shoulders and a small pull-off visible; (3) falls in a tree plantation ~60 m from a gravel turnaround lot. The pin is on the clear main camp. No ford, 4WD note or posted limit.

SEASON CONFLICT (season group is manual 'year_round: true' with a note about refuge closures, so this result does not touch it): checked each camping spot against the map's hatchings. Spot (1), the pinned field, is drawn inside the vertical-line hatch of unit 14 = 'Waterfowl Hunting Only Zone 1 (Oct. 15 - Feb. 15)', at its corner beside the county road; the cross-hatched pool 13 immediately north across the levee road is 'Waterfowl Refuge (Closed to all uses Oct. 15 - Mar. 31)'. Spots (2) and (3) are at the edge of / inside the diagonal hatch 'Waterfowl Hunting Only Zone 2 (Oct. 15 - end of Middle Zone Season)'. The brochure: 'Non-waterfowl hunters are prohibited from the "Waterfowl Hunt Only Zones" during the waterfowl hunting season, unless they are properly licensed members of and remain with a party authorized to use the area'; the area page's Rule 186: 'Only authorized persons are allowed within the waterfowl shooting areas during the waterfowl hunting season'. Neither says in so many words that the camping field is shut, and the field is a roadside corner the hatch may simply overrun at map scale - but read as drawn, camping at the pin is not available to an ordinary visitor from Oct 15 to Feb 15 (as at Nodaway Valley). QUESTION for AWH: change season to opens 02-16 / closes 10-14 with that note, or keep year-round with the caveat? I put the caveat in the entry note meanwhile. The stored season note ('Cypress Lake to the end of duck season') describes the refuge, which does not cover any camping spot.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): the pinned field's nearest water is managed, seasonally flooded wetland pools ~40-60 m west behind a ditch and treeline and north across the levee road; Cypress Lake is ~600 m north. Spots (2)/(3) are near the St. Francis River and a drainage ditch but under canopy, and are not the pin.

PIN: stored 36.71374,-90.10151 = GIS point 43 in the open field - fine. No split: spots (2)/(3) are 4 km away on other roads but are single small roadside spots, not a camping area with more than a small lot.
PHONE: (573) 624-5821 on the area page (and brochure) matches.
